title: Where were you?
subtitle: A tired Tuesday — was and were
canDo: I can say where I was yesterday.
I can ask questions like Where were you? and Was it difficult?
I can understand a short text about the past.
teacherNotes: Geçmiş zamana giriş: was / were. Tahtaya: am, is → was; are → were. Türkçedeki -di (idi) ekiyle karşılaştırın.
Hızlı soru oyunu: "Where were you at 8 a.m. yesterday / last night / on Sunday?" Öğrenciler "I was at …" ile cevaplasın.
"When were you born? — I was born in …" kalıbını kalıp olarak verin; born'u ayrıca açıklamaya gerek yok.
Rose'un fotoğrafı: öğrencilerden eski bir fotoğraflarını açıp "This is me in … I was … years old." diye anlatmalarını isteyin.

items.example: I was at work last night.
There was a test last week.
I was in bed all day.
He works on Monday nights, remember?

lines.speaker: lucas

lines.text: Yes, it was. It was about the weather. And there was a test!

lines.speaker: lucas
lines.text: And where's Omar? Is he sick too?

lines.speaker: elif

lines.text: He was at work last night. He works on Monday nights, remember?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Good morning, everyone! Lucas, you're back. Were you sick?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Good. And Omar … were you at the hospital last night?

sections.title: Read
sections.heading: Rose's old photo
sections.intro: Rose shows Elif a photo from 1978.
paragraphs: This is me in 1978. I was twenty years old.
I was a student at a university here in Boston.
The girl next to me is Dorothy. She was my best friend then, and she's my best friend now!
We were in the same class at school.
We weren't very good students, but we were very happy.
My first job was at the library on Harbor Street. I was there for forty years.
Were my days boring? No, they weren't.
There were always interesting people and wonderful books.

sections.title: Grammar: was and were
rules: Short answers: Yes, I **was**. / No, they **weren't**.
**There was** a test. **There were** interesting people.

support.tr: was / were, be fiilinin geçmiş hâlidir (Türkçede -di / idi). I was tired = Yorgundum. am ve is → was, are → were. Olumsuz: wasn't / weren't = değildim, değildik. Soru: Were you at home? = Evde miydin? Türkçede -di eki kelimeye eklenir, İngilizcede was / were ayrı bir kelimedir.
support.ar: was / were هما ماضي فعل be (كان). I was tired = كنتُ متعبًا. am و is ← was، و are ← were. النفي: wasn't / weren't = لم أكن / لم يكونوا. السؤال: Were you at home? = هل كنتَ في البيت؟ في العربية نقول «كان» للمفرد و«كانوا» للجمع، وفي الإنجليزية نستخدم were مع you و we و they.

tr.note: Türkçede "hastaydım" tek kelime; İngilizcede was'ı ayrı yaz. you ile her zaman were kullan.

ar.note: لا تحذف was / were في الماضي، ولا تستخدم was مع they.

sections.title: Practice
sections.instructions: Complete with was, were, wasn't or weren't.

support.tr: was, were, wasn't veya weren't ile tamamla.
support.ar: أكمل بـ was أو were أو wasn't أو weren't.

items: {Was} the test difficult? — No, it {wasn't|was not}.
Rose and Dorothy {were} best friends at school.
Where {were} you last night? — I {was} at work.
We {weren't|were not} at home on Sunday. We were at the park.

sections.title: Questions and answers
sections.instructions: Match the question and the answer.
pairs: Were you at work last night?

items.audio: On Sunday, I was at the beach with Biscuit all day. It was lovely.
Last night, Dorothy and I were at the library. There was a talk about old Boston.
I wasn't at the university yesterday. I was at Grandma Fatima's house.
Sorry I was late this morning. My bus was twenty minutes late!

sections.title: Write: Yesterday

model.heading: Yesterday — Omar
text: At nine in the morning, I was in class with Elif and Lucas. Oh, no, Lucas wasn't there!
At one o'clock, I was at the supermarket.
At eight in the evening, I was at the hospital. I was at work all night.
It was a long day, and now I'm very tired.

frame: At nine in the morning, I was ___.
At one o'clock, I was ___ with ___.
sections.prompt: Where were you yesterday? Who were you with? How was your day? Write 5 or 6 sentences.

support.tr: Dün neredeydin? Kiminle birlikteydin? Günün nasıldı? 5–6 cümle yaz.
support.ar: أين كنتَ أمس؟ مع مَن كنت؟ كيف كان يومك؟ اكتب 5 أو 6 جمل.

checklist: I use one negative: wasn't / weren't.
I use times: at nine, in the evening.
